title: エルムSの後に・がまん、がまん！

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and head back, Trainer!
choice_data_list: You're not happy you got first?
You're not happy you got first?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I could dance! Buuut…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I've still got a ways to go, right? I gotta win even more races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I gotta hurry up and get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I need to get first again and again and again! Then people will have to take me seriously!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And once everyone takes me seriously, I'm sure my friends will be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara really has changed from her days of just doing everything for fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finally has a real hunger for victory.
choice_data_list: Then you better win the next race!
Then you better win the next race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And… I wanna enter a G1!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: G1 races are a big deal, right? So I wanna win one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is the first time Haru Urara has asked for a specific type of race! For a moment, I'm taken aback by her growth. After a moment, though, I make a suggestion.
choice_data_list: Then how about the JBC Sprint?
Then how about the JBC Sprint?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a sprint on a dirt course, which is what she excels at. I think she has a great shot at getting first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set our sights on taking first place in the JBC Sprint!
